show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Barry Diller - Building An Entertainment Empire - [Invest Like the Best, EP.441]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Barry is the former CEO of Paramount Pictures, Fox Broadcasting, and the founder of IAC.
reader_summary.overview: Barry is the former CEO of Paramount Pictures, Fox Broadcasting, and the founder of IAC. He has been at the center of every major media transformation over the past five decades. Barry reveals his "creative conflict" philosophy - pushing smart, opinionated people past their endurance point to generate breakthrough ideas.

key_points.text: He has been at the center of every major media transformation over the past five decades.
He also shares stories of working alongside media titans like Rupert Murdoch and Bill Gates.
We discuss his current portfolio strategy, innovation in media, and how personal struggles can become professional superpowers.
